## Projects

- Impulse IDE: desktop IDE for Arduino and IoT boards with an AI agent built in. Compile, upload and serial monitor in one window; an error-memory system reuses past build fixes. Electron, Arduino CLI.
- Smart SOS Helmet: crash-detection helmet. An MPU6050 senses impact, a 5-second buzzer window lets the rider cancel a false alarm, then the ESP and a companion app send GPS location and an emergency call.
- Smart Yoga Mat: real-time pose estimation that compares posture against the correct form and gives corrections. Custom hardware with ESP32-CAM as standalone vision module. MediaPipe, YOLO, Python.
- Game of Codes: browser game that teaches C++ by making real code the game mechanic. Government-funded, 100+ learners. https://www.gameofcodes.io/
- NudgeUpp: posture-tracking Android app, built as freelance work and shipped to the Play Store.

## Skills

- Embedded and IoT: Arduino, ESP, Arduino Cloud, sensor integration (MPU6050), C/C++
- Design and simulation: Cadence, KiCad, EasyEDA, Verilog, MATLAB, computer-network simulation
- AI / ML: Python, MediaPipe, YOLO; 8+ models trained (pose estimation, healthcare disease prediction, Green AI)
- Software: JavaScript, Electron, app development and automation
